GDX/GLD ratio technical analysis — 3 multi-timeframe charts showing:

Long-term (2007–2026): GDX/GLD downtrend from 0.60 → 0.2467 (junior miners severely underperforming)

Medium-term (2017–2026): Consolidation recovery pattern forming in 0.15–0.30 range

Short-term (2025–2026): Bullish 1-week breakout with improving RSI momentum; recovery structure above 0.16 support, testing overhead resistance 0.23–0.24
Technical setup: Gold/silver miners correlation inflection — aligns with WR's prior GOLD macro thesis (XAUUSD/SPX ratio bottoming Aug 24). Structural retest setup forming in junior miners sector.
